name: PhD Program in Biomedical Sciences
institution: Mayo Clinic Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences
location: Rochester, Minnesota; Jacksonville, Florida; Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona
detailsNote: How students are admitted (program, track or lab) is not clearly stated on the pages read: track choice is made in the application and confirmed after admission, and rotations are not mentioned.
summary: PhD program in Biomedical Sciences at Mayo Clinic Graduate School, on three campuses. Students apply to a track and have a guaranteed five-year internal fellowship.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The How to Apply page says applications must be received between Sept. 1 and Dec. 2 and that no updates are accepted after Dec. 2, 2026. The page says to apply for "the following academic year". No time is given.

timeline.interviews: Interview invitations are emailed December through January; interviews are conducted January through February (time frames subject to change).
timeline.decisions: Initial appointment letters March to April; final decisions April to May.

english.note: Proof of English proficiency is required for international applicants who are non-native English speakers. No test or minimum score is named on the pages read.

applicationFee.note: The page says there is no application fee for applying to the Ph.D. program.

documents: Unofficial transcripts of all courses taken at colleges or universities
Personal statement of one to two pages, single-spaced
requirements.note: Letters sent directly to the school are not accepted. Incomplete applications are not reviewed.

funding.note: The page says the graduate school pays the stipends and fees of all graduate students, with a guaranteed five-year internal fellowship covering full tuition, stipend and benefits.
